noi_dung:
PART TEN

THE FUTURE OF HUMANITY

THE AQUARIUS AGE AND THE EARTH'S TRANSITIONAL PERIOD

I was so excited that that afternoon I flew to Chicago to visit billionaire Farnum's house. After looking at the documents I brought about Service Space and knowing that my husband and I had decided to merge our assets with his foundation to join hands in many small projects that have great impact and meaning to everyone, especially the young people, the seeds of a good future for humanity, Farnum was extremely moved. He thanked me for accompanying him on this journey. We talked for a long time about our future plans, starting with contributing to existing projects like Service Space, then moving on to new projects.

After leaving Mr. Farnum's house, on the way home, Angie and I decided to take some time to rest before embarking on and pouring our hearts into implementing these projects. So we turned to Colorado.

Our vacation house is quite special in that it is located on a hill overlooking a beautiful small lake. The time we went there was early spring. One morning, Angie excitedly invited me to walk down to the lake together:

- We have been here many times but have never gone down to that lake. I see that around this natural lake there seems to be a path that can be walked around. Let's go down there for a walk!

I agree because after cold snowy days, there's nothing better than warm spring weather and a leisurely walk. We followed the small road leading down to the lake. Perhaps because no one has been there for a long time, the trees have grown densely. As I walked, I had to push aside tree branches growing around the path. When approaching the lake, I was surprised to see a land planted with lots of flowers, full of bright and vibrant colors. Angie was also surprised and admired:

- I didn't expect there to be so many beautiful flowers in this wild place!

I observed the flower bushes and said:

- This flower must have someone to grow it like that.

We walked and looked at the colorful flower bushes, giving off a fragrant scent to a corner of the forest. Just past a corner, I saw the silhouette of a silver-haired woman struggling among the flower bushes. We approached and saw her nurturing the roots of some sunflowers. Angie said hello. The old woman turned around, not showing any surprise when she saw us, but just happily returned the greeting. Looking at her appearance, I guessed that the old woman was about eighty years old. Her demeanor exudes an unusually worldly look, with a feeling of gentleness, closeness, and a bit of separation. While I stood silently observing, Angie quickly started talking:

- We have been on the hill for a long time but did not expect that down here there would be a flower garden as beautiful and fragrant as this.

The old woman happily introduced herself:

- I heard that someone bought Mr. Hart's house on the hill, maybe it's you and your wife. Please allow me to introduce myself, I am Dorothy.

Angie also introduced herself and continued to admire the garden:

- I have never seen a place with as many beautiful flowers as this place. It must have taken a lot of effort and dedication?

With leisurely movements, Dorothy continued to nurture the flower bushes and happily explained:

- Growing flowers is a way to establish a relationship between humans and nature. For me, taking care of plants and flowers is a process of nurturing and enriching the soul. The green color of leaves symbolizes innovation. Every day when I look at the flowers sprouting, I feel very happy, all my worries disappear. Sometimes I wonder, am I taking care of the flowers or are the flowers taking care of me?

Angie became even more interested:

- I didn't expect that growing flowers contained so much meaning! Hearing her say that, I know how much she loves this job.

Mrs. Dorothy still did not stop, happily explaining further:

- Time spent with trees helps me understand nature more, so I receive more and more blessings every day. I know how to listen to the music of birds, enjoy the dance of butterflies and flowers, and understand the sound of the wind whispering through the leaves, all like an orchestra that reminds us to live each day to the fullest by prioritizing what needs to be done to make life better.

Even though she didn't stop working, the old woman still noticed me attentively looking at the flower beds. She turned to me and asked:

- Among all kinds of flowers, which one do you like the most?

I answered without thinking:

- For me, every flower has its own beauty. However, I like these sunflowers, because they are both beautiful and brilliant, always facing the sun.

The old woman smiled, looking mysterious, then turned to Angie:

- What about you? Which flower do you like?

Angie smiled:

- I like fleur de lis the most so I often display this flower in my house.

The old woman observed us and asked:

- Now, let me guess. Is he a Leo and she is a Taurus?

I didn't understand what the old woman wanted to say, then Angie responded with surprise and delight:

- How do you know our zodiac sign? Surely you have experience studying astrology?

The old woman shook her head and smiled:

- No, it can't be called research, it's just a pastime for a free old person like me. I study and observe the stars to learn about the connection between the universe and humans. And because I love flowers, I can guess the connection between people and plants and flowers.

Angie was surprised:

- But how did you know my zodiac sign so accurately?

The old woman happily answered:

- Because she likes fleur de lis. This flower symbolizes artistic talent and dedication to caring for others. It is a flower suitable for the nature of people belonging to the Taurus zodiac sign, who is emotional, rich in sentiment, likes to decorate and display beautiful things, because this zodiac sign is influenced by Venus.

Angie laughed with excitement:

- You guessed right, I am indeed a Taurus. But what about my house?

The old woman turned to look at me and slowly replied:

- Sunflowers are not only larger than other flowers but also have vibrant colors. It is a flower suitable for courageous, confident people, with the power to attract the attention of others, like the influence of the sun. That is the characteristic of people belonging to the Leo zodiac sign. Am I right?

I have heard about astrology and mysticism before but didn't pay much attention. But Angie has mentioned the fact that I am a Leo many times, so when I heard the old woman say that, I nodded in confirmation. Hearing that, Angie became even more interested so she asked more:

- Great! So when you look at the stars, what else do you see?

Mrs. Dorothy stopped and stood up to face us. She radiates friendliness and comfort. She happily answered:

- According to astrology, all changes on earth are affected by the position and movement of the planets in the solar system. Depending on which constellation the sun is located in, its magnetic force shining on the earth and human life will be different. This influence lasts about 2,150 years called the cycle, in which the first 80 to 150 years are the transition period between two cycles (Cusp of Ages). This is when the influence of the old cycle disintegrates and a new cycle takes shape. Currently, the earth is in the middle of the Pisces and Aquarius cycle.

Angie curiously asked:

- So how will this influence happen?

Mrs. Dorothy explained:

- The transition period is a period when many unexpected and rapid changes will occur. Of course, the methods for calculating stellar positions are still controversial, so my observation is not necessarily correct. However, according to my calculations, from 1930 to 2050 is the transition period between the two cycles, where old values ​​are eliminated to open a new era, a period in which human consciousness will change and develop much more than before.

Angie was surprised:

- You mean people will be smarter than before?

Mrs. Dorothy smiled and replied:

- Not only intelligence will be developed, but human consciousness will expand to reach a completely new understanding. The Age of Pisces has influenced beliefs and doctrines, so human understanding is still limited to what has been taught. That was the era when religion developed very strongly, and at the same time it was also the period of the rise of doctrines, theories, and ideologies that required a certain belief. This limited trust causes people to become conservative and selfish, leading to division, discrimination between religions, theories, factions, and sometimes even extremes or fanaticism. Therefore, for the past two thousand years, wars have occurred everywhere, starting from ambitious emperors to extremely cruel dictators.

Angie nodded:

- So that's it... But how will the future change?

Mrs. Dorothy continued:

- When the world moves into the age of Aquarius, human knowledge will develop strongly and will no longer be limited. This era will put an end to discriminatory and conservative trends as well as unreasonable beliefs stemming from old narrow-minded, habitual, superstitious and unscientific theories. The symbol of Aquarius is the person carrying the water bottle. Water symbolizes knowledge, sharing, empathy and love. Therefore, I believe that the coming era will help people develop new knowledge to build a better world, no longer distinguishing between skin color, religion, faction or hatred like before.

I listened to Mrs. Dorothy's explanation and immediately thought of Farnum's prediction about the change that would take place in the future. Both have many similarities although one is based on near-death experiences while the other talks about stellar influences.

The duty of parents is to teach their children to be filial, to become honest citizens, to love their family, to focus on the fatherland, to protect the nation, to build and do useful things for the country.

Seeing Angie and I listening attentively, Mrs. Dorothy was inspired to continue:

- When knowledge is expanded, a science will be built with unexpected new inventions. However, during the transition period between these two cycles, there will be purges to eliminate those who cannot change, are not qualified enough, and are not virtuous enough to be suitable for the new era. Therefore, a series of wars, epidemics, and natural disasters will occur, and the level will become more and more terrible than before, as a result, only a few people will survive. This has been called the final judgment by religions before humanity enters the new age. Through star observations, I can say that right now is when the disturbance is intense. Humanity is torn between two ideological trends. On one side is the brutal materialism and blind fanaticism of religion, and on the other side is the knowledge of divine wisdom and cosmic science with profound laws that have not yet been discovered or recognized.

Speaking of that, Mrs. Dorothy was suddenly startled and confused:

- Sorry... I probably said too much. Living in this remote place, it's not often I meet people who are compatible to chat with... I'm happy to talk nonsense, please forgive me.

Angie quickly replied:

- No, no, we are very happy to hear you talk. Her knowledge is very interesting. If I have a chance, I would like to hear more from her...

Mrs. Dorothy smiled and waved her hand:

- I've said too much already... wasting your time. I don't dare to interrupt my grandparents' walk. However, please wait a moment, I have a small gift for you.

The old woman quickly entered a small house nearby. A moment later, she walked out with a bright bouquet of flowers in her hand:

- I have a small gift, I hope you will accept it.

Angie looked surprised at the bouquet of fleur-de-lis in the old woman's hand:

- Thank you, the fleur-de-lis are so beautiful. But... where are these flowers this season?

The old woman happily explained:

- I grow in a greenhouse so there are all kinds of flowers in every season.

We happily received the bouquet of flowers and said goodbye to Mrs. Dorothy, thanking her for the conversation and continuing to walk around the lake before returning home.

The next day when I visited Mr. Kris, I told him about Mrs. Dorothy. Mr. Kris said:

- Everyone around here knows that Mrs. Dorothy has a garden that grows a lot of flowers, including very rare flowers.

I also told about Mrs. Dorothy's prediction and asked him what he thought about it. Mr. Kris listened and then said:

- Today's popular astrology originally started in Egypt, with a long history. Since ancient times, Egyptian priests have calculated the movement of stars to apply in mystical rituals as well as to build great structures such as the Pyramids. Egyptian astrology is based on the position of the sun, moon and constellations, considers relationships and then divides them into cycles. Each Great Cycle lasts about 26,000 years, symbolizing an era, a civilization or a cycle of Formation - Dwelling - Destruction - Destruction. Each Great Cycle is divided into 12 Sub-Cycles, each Sub-Cycle lasting about 2,100 years. The sun's Cosmic Ray shines down on the earth, passing through the constellations, like light passing through stained glass and being colored by it. Since each constellation has its own specific elements, it also affects changes on earth. Therefore, the influence of the constellations is the foundation for other elements to be expressed. When Egyptian civilization declined, astrology was transmitted to Assyria and Babylon, but the quintessential values ​​were more or less lost. The Babylonians combined Egyptian astrology with Indian astrology to create a method of calculating the movements of the stars in relation to human destiny. From there, forms of divination, horoscopes, and casting good and bad hexagrams began. When Alexander conquered Persia, Greek scholars studied Babylonian astrology, but they eliminated some details that were considered unreasonable, establishing a more scientific astrological system. Later, the Romans perfected this system into today's astrology.

Mr. Kris paused thoughtfully and then continued:

- When Greek scholars reviewed Babylonian astrological documents, they overlooked an important element that they considered unreasonable. That is the factor that talks about the influence of the earth on the other constellations. Because of their fervent belief in gods, Greek astrology only focused on the influence of stars on the earth and did not believe in the opposite direction. This is understandable, because Greek scholars still believe that there are gods living in heaven who control human destiny. Therefore, the astrology of the Greeks, then the Romans, was flawed, not as complete as the astrology of Babylon and India.

I said:

- Mrs. Dorothy mentioned a glorious future of the coming Aquarius era. I don't know if this information is accurate?

Mr. Kris explained:

- That prediction also has some value. If we look at history through the ages, we can see the stellar influence on human life. For example, the period from 4,000 to 2,000 BC is the Age of Taurus. This era belongs to the Earth element, laying the foundation for material activities such as construction and conservation. The most obvious evidence is the construction of pyramids, tombs, and mausoleums of kings. Construction techniques and methods at that time were far more developed than today because the Egyptians learned construction techniques from the Atlanteans. They know how to apply sunlight and the energy of precious stones to analyze matter into atoms to move giant rocks from one place to another. Today, the science of quantum physics (Quantum Physics) has proven this through the interference phenomenon of matter (Qubit) existing in two different places.

Mr. Kris smiled and looked at me:

- Of course you already know this. Thanks to the knowledge of using sunlight and dimensional energy, Egyptian priests and architects changed physical structures to carry giant boulders weighing tens of tons from far away places to construction sites. Its principle is to carry matter from three-dimensional space into four-dimensional space without encountering any obstacles. At the construction site, they transferred that matter back into three-dimensional space and the rocks returned to their previous state. Thanks to their knowledge of the magnetic force flows of the universe and the gravitational pull of the moon, they were able to lose the weight of matter and move giant rocks up to build the Pyramid. When Egyptian civilization declined, this knowledge was lost. After thousands of years, no one can trace this technique anymore.

Mr. Kris laughed cheerfully:

- Currently, people have tried to use modern understanding and technology to understand this construction. They cannot explain why ancient people were able to move rocks weighing hundreds of tons from remote mountains into the desert to build the Pyramid, while today, science has used modern machinery and equipment but still cannot do the same. There is a theory that boats on the Nile River were the main transportation route for transporting these rocks. However, science cannot prove that the fragile wooden boats of the Egyptians at that time could hold rocks weighing thousands of pounds. Science also cannot find the answer to how, with only rudimentary ropes and slave labor, the ancients were able to pull giant rocks up high to complete such great architecture. They don't know why large, heavy rocks can fit tightly on top of each other without a gap. How could they create architecture with such high precision with the rudimentary measuring tools of that time? The reason they cannot explain these things is because they use the thinking of this era to speculate about the past. Although many hypotheses have been proposed, no one has been able to prove anything. Because they do not understand that each era has completely different knowledge and techniques, depending on people's understanding at that time. Just like a few centuries ago, if it was said that humans could fly into space and set foot on the moon, no one would believe it.

Mr. Kris added:

- Pride in experimental science has made people blind. They believe that thanks to science, humanity has progressed to where it is today. Everything that cannot be proven by science is considered unscientific or superstitious. Today, people are proud of the invention of the computer, which ushered in the technological age. Few people know that computers have been invented thousands of years ago. The simplest calculator is the Chinese abacus, which dates back to BC. Several decades ago, a Greek diver found a bronze machine with dozens of cog wheels, called Antikythera, at the bottom of the Mediterranean Sea. Through archaeological analysis, it is known that this apparatus is more than 2,000 years old. It is a computer used to track the movements of stars in the solar system. It calculated the positions of stars moving around the sun with excellent precision. Through the symbols engraved on the rotation of the wheels, it is proven that it is based on a complex mathematical system. Scientists had to exclaim that the brain of the genius who invented that machine must be extremely superior. In short, we cannot hastily conclude that the science of the past cannot be compared with today.

I pondered what Mr. Kris had just said and then asked:

- Going back to astrology, what do you think about Dorothy's prediction?

Mr. Kris explained:

- Greek astrology is based on the position and relationship between the sun, moon and constellations to divide it into 12 zodiac signs. Because each constellation has its own specific life waves, people can speculate on its influence on the earth. For example, the Pisces cycle influences the growth of faith, while the Aquarius cycle influences the advancement of knowledge. Currently, the Pisces cycle is in its final phase, so beliefs are collapsing one by one, making people confused and scared because they no longer know what to believe. All the beliefs they were taught in the past suddenly became outdated. All theories and dogmas become empty, no longer valid, and people feel like they have been deceived. Meanwhile, new knowledge of technology has a strong attraction to young people today. Instead of looking to faith, they look to technology. Instead of praying, they share everything with each other via social networks. Nowadays, people believe in technology just like previous generations believed in religion. However, my question is, is this technology that is considered modern the knowledge of the Age of Aquarius as Mrs. Dorothy said? This is something we need to reconsider.

Mr. Kris explained further:

- As we have mentioned many times, in the age of advanced technology, the human mind has mostly been dominated by machines and has gradually become passive and less thoughtful, thus becoming less and less clear-headed. Lack of knowledge and naive blind trust in technology will cause people to lose their ability to be autonomous. Inner wisdom is replaced by technological products that are powerfully attractive and instructive. As a result, today's young people who grow up with technology can become foolish and have difficulty thinking deeply and thoroughly. He can see that recently many young people live dreamily like sleepwalking because they live in the virtual world more than in the real world. Under the label of entertainment, more and more products are being invented that encourage people to live virtually. This enriches some unscrupulous companies, and humanity's intelligence will be controlled by these technology products. When humanity replaces internal intelligence with artificial intelligence, soon they will no longer be able to use their minds and let machines make decisions for them. So, according to you, is this the so-called good knowledge of the Aquarius era?

I gently shook my head. Mr. Kris smiled and continued:

- Mrs. Dorothy believes that the influence of the Aquarius constellation will affect knowledge, which is not wrong. However, how this knowledge is expressed is not only influenced one way from this constellation on the earth, but the opposite direction also plays an important role. Babylonian and Indian astrology was more accurate because their knowledge was based on two-way interaction. The laws of the universe must be balanced because everything, everything is interdependent and interpenetrating, it cannot be one-way.

I immediately asked:

- So how does the earth affect other planets?

Mr. Kris continued:

- As far as I know, the influence of stars in the age of Aquarius will build the basis for knowledge of the manifested laws of the universe. The Earth is the environment of human activity. If we want to know events that happen to humanity, we need to clearly understand the interaction of the Earth with the laws of the universe. The more we understand, the more clearly we see how these universal laws govern the world. Once understood, people will act in accordance with these laws, no longer haphazardly or unconsciously like before. That is exactly what will happen in the coming era.

Mr. Kris paused for a moment to think, then added:

- As a planet, the earth also emits life waves to related constellations. These constellations will reflect back to the earth what it receives, but this reflection has passed through the influence of that constellation. This is an important factor to understand human destiny. One cannot study astrology without talking about universal laws such as the law of Cause and Effect. In fact, stars only reflect the waves of life happening on earth. Human consciousness as well as their actions emit waves of life into space. Therefore, what happens in the future depends on the karma of humanity.

I nodded:

- So... So what about the transition period between the two cycles that Mrs. Dorothy mentioned. How do you think this happened?

Mr. Kris replied:

- She's right. Before entering the age of Aquarius, the earth must go through a transition period. This is the time when there will be many changes and disturbances to erase the remnants of the previous cycle and clear the way for the next cycle. In addition to the collapse of theoretical, ideological, and dogmatic beliefs that take place on the spiritual level, people will see a series of natural disasters such as famine, drought, forest fires, epidemics, or earthquakes occurring more and more violently. This is not something new because it has been warned about for a long time. But why did no one do anything after knowing? Because if we take action and make changes to prevent these things, it may be detrimental to the economies of some countries, making them disadvantaged. Therefore, despite knowing the consequences, greed, selfishness, and indifference arose and overwhelmed everything else, causing these countries to leave everything until it was too late.

Mr. Kris looked at me attentively and continued:

- He works in the financial sector, perhaps he clearly saw the economic decline that had begun a few years ago. The most typical is the decline in the food production sector in some countries. The cause is war, drought, floods, and hot weather. However, for now, this only affects a few countries, so human society has not collapsed during this time.

Mr. Kris pointed to the window where the sunlight shone on the unmelted snow still on the lawn and said:

- Everyone knows that the earth is warming as a result of the pollution that humans have caused during the process of technological and industrial development. When temperatures increase, the weather is also affected. Therefore, recently, storms, hurricanes, floods, and forest fires have occurred more and more frequently, with increasing severity and unpredictable developments. However, people still believe that natural disasters are caused by nature. No one can do anything, so no one wants to change their comfortable and happy lifestyle. They believe that if these events do not directly affect them, they do not need to care. This insensitivity continues until natural disasters occur everywhere, all over the world, causing great consequences and affecting the global economy. The economic crisis will transform into a social crisis, making human life more insecure and difficult. Social crisis will lead to loss of confidence in leaders, creating political instability and social riots. This is not something new, economic and environmental experts have been talking about this issue for a long time. However, even though they know, no one wants to do anything until the right thing comes.

Mr. Kris sighed:

- Greed drives some companies to continue using advanced techniques to maximize natural resource exploitation, despite the difficulties that some other countries have to deal with. Although there have been warning signs of famine, water scarcity and political riots, humans continue to fully exploit these few remaining resources. Economic theory encourages increased profits, so people continue to destroy forests, cut mountains, cut down trees, kill animals, and pour polluted chemicals into rivers, ponds, and creeks, causing serious damage to nature. When the natural environment is irreversibly destroyed, polluted plants cannot be eaten or cannot even grow, famine will spread throughout the world. At that time, a large number of people will have to leave the country, searching for food everywhere to find a place to live. This great migration phenomenon will create social, political, and economic changes throughout the world.

In the near future, food and clean water will be two important factors that make countries willing to go to war and destroy each other just for the sake of survival. Strong countries will invade weaker countries to occupy arable land as well as areas with rivers and water sources. That was the time when people became ignorant in order to survive and no longer knew the difference between right and wrong. They think that if you don't take from others, others will take from you. If you don't kill others, others will kill you. Therefore, all countries, large and small, compete and appropriate amenities to survive. When hatred is high, when cruelty reaches its peak, war will occur everywhere, and the number of deaths will reach unimaginable numbers.

One cannot study astrology without talking about universal laws such as the law of Cause and Effect. In fact, stars only reflect the waves of life happening on earth. Human consciousness as well as their actions emit waves of life into space. Therefore, what happens in the future depends on the karma of humanity.

Mr. Kris was silent as if thinking about something then continued:

- Everyone knows that epidemics such as flu, smallpox, plague... all have vaccines, but there are also epidemics for which all methods of prevention are no longer valid. These bacteria can continually mutate, rendering vaccination ineffective. Even worse, in the future, some bacteria of this disease will also combine with bacteria of other diseases to become a type of super bacteria that is extremely destructive and cannot be cured. In nature, bacteria cannot combine together like that, but with advanced technology in today's laboratories, changing genetic factors and hybridization can create extremely toxic artificial bacteria, biological weapons that can kill millions of people in just a short time.

I pondered:

- Recently, it is true that the world has had such changes. If things become more and more serious as he said, soon people will have to face great tribulation.

Mr. Kris added, a worried look on his face:

- I think you must know this clearly. This is also what happened at Atlantis. And the cruel people of the past are reincarnated again, continuing to breed such unnatural creatures. Because they know how to transplant the genetic cells of one organism into the body of another, they know how to change human genetic cells with animal genetic cells, to produce hybrid monsters with unusual abilities. This has happened in the past but will happen again in the near future. Even though they have gone through millions of reincarnations to learn, their old habits still remain unchanged. Currently, creatures with terrible harm are being researched in biological weapons laboratories. Soon, humanity will witness monsters capable of doing even more terrible things. With modern biotechnology and the development of artificial intelligence, creating these deformed, deformed monsters is within the realm of possibility.

I shivered, recalling the scary memories of Atlantis returning. Images of half-human, half-animal monsters, emotionless, inhumane and extremely cruel monsters suddenly appeared clearly in my mind. I sighed:

- Mr. Kris, if something like that happened again, it would be terrible. I still remember how terrifying the end of Atlantis was.

Mr. Kris nodded:

- Currently, he has seen the emergence of airborne diseases that, in just a short period of time, have killed millions of people. A sick person can simply cough and transmit the disease to others. In the past few years, not only have a series of patients died, but also doctors and nurses have died from this disease. However, that is only the opening stage for other devastating epidemics that are about to occur in the near future. Some come from nature, some from secret laboratories. At this point, no one can distinguish or investigate the cause anymore. Once these epidemics occur, they will destroy a large part of humanity without anyone being able to stop them.

Mr. Kris was silent as if in admiration and then continued:

- All people have different karma. Doing good will result in good results, doing evil will result in evil results. Depending on the cause, what kind of retribution you will experience. Many people still do not believe in cause and effect, because they see cruel people who are still unscathed, even rich and happy. They do not understand how the law of Cause and Effect of the universe works and only see things in a limited way. A human life of a hundred years seems long, but it is just like a flash of light in the universe. How could they know how these people had done good deeds in the past and were now born in a rich and good place, enjoying such glory, eating well and dressing comfortably? Even though they are doing bad things now, it is because the good results from before have ripened while the evil results have not yet. Until the evil fruit ripens, they will certainly encounter bad retribution. Likewise, there are people in this life who do good deeds but suffer many disadvantages and sufferings because they committed evil deeds in their previous lives and must pay back the evil consequences. When the good results of this life are ripe, you will only enjoy the good results.

I wonder:

- But good or evil is only relative. Each person has a different definition, what is good in one place can also be bad in another...

Mr. Kris interrupted me:

- No, anything that benefits everyone is a good thing. If you help people out of love and not to gain fame or reward, then that is a good deed. When you work sincerely, not selfishly, not for personal gain, not thinking about yourself but only caring for others, that is a good deed. On the contrary, if you do anything that harms others or benefits you, it is an evil act. The standard for distinguishing between good and evil is self-introspection to see who the action benefits? If you do it for others, it is a good deed. If you do it for your own benefit and harm others, it is an unhealthy deed.

Mr. Kris paused to let me think and then continued:

- The major powers today are all secretly working on creating weapons with tremendous destructive power. They are creating huge negative karma for which they will have to pay very heavy consequences. He can see that countries that produce guns and weapons and encourage other countries to wage war to sell weapons will face consequences when their own people use the weapons they make to kill each other. You will see that countries that have devastated other countries with bombs or nuclear weapons will suffer unimaginable karma when the people of that country suffer from all kinds of strange diseases, abnormal bodies, madness, panic... Once karma comes, no one can avoid it. The law of the universe is extremely balanced, it cannot be otherwise. For a long time now, the ideology of greed, selfishness, indifference, and only knowing how to benefit oneself, stemming from inhuman theories and dictatorial leaders with the power to attract the masses, has spread everywhere, turning into negative forces affecting the stars. During this period of transition, that negative force is reflected onto the earth creating unexpected changes. Why are there natural disasters, epidemics or wars? Because the human mind is greedy, hateful, and delusional, all day long, we only think about how to benefit ourselves without thinking about others. Some people have become emotionless and lost their humanity. This world belongs to humans, but if humans are no longer human, what will happen?

I'm skeptical:

- But this earth is not necessarily only people, of humans... There are other animals too.

Mr. Kris nodded:

- That's right. But have you forgotten that in the cycle of reincarnation, it is normal to be a human being and an animal reincarnation? When suffering, they learn a little to transform, but then in happiness they forget everything. In that vicious circle, people and things are inseparable. Therefore, the negative force of the earth is something that all things are responsible for. Currently, the world is getting worse with changes, events and disasters before the earth enters the Aquarius cycle.

I ask:

- So what will the world be like when it enters the Aquarius cycle?

Mr. Kris leisurely said:

- After a series of extremely violent natural disasters, after extremely harmful human disasters, after terrible epidemics and devastating wars, only a few people will survive. Only through experiencing these terrible events can humanity understand clearly what it means to be a human being on this earth. Thanks to learning and applying universal laws to life, human life in the coming era will not be like today. Knowledge at that time will be knowledge about the relationship between humans and the universe. Science then will be a science that looks inward to know itself, not outward like today. At that time, humanity knew how to love, share, help each other, and know how to do things that benefit everyone. Only after experiencing grief and change, when living, people will know how to love and cherish each other like close brothers. Only then will people feel ashamed of their past actions, know how to change their thinking, know how to abandon evil and do good, and know how to build the moral and ethical concepts that are still available. Only then can they live in a useful, good, and compassionate way. At that time, there will be no more discrimination or discrimination, because their minds have expanded and turned towards goodness. The vibrations of human thought in the new era will be many times lighter than the vibrations of humanity's consciousness today. This is the Construction phase of the new cycle, everyone knows humanity and morality, there are no longer selfish thoughts and self-interest. From there, these people will start building a new era, a new society with new people because they completely believe in the eternal truths in the universe. Also in this era, there will be a number of master souls who will achieve absolute freedom, escape samsara and ascend to experience higher dimensions of the universe. Among them, there will be many who choose to return to reincarnation on earth to continue helping those who are still on the journey towards absolute freedom.

Mr. Kris paused, he looked at me as if sending a message, then concluded:

- But why wait until then? Why not start those things right now? Why not be aware of your responsibility to the earth, to other creatures and change life to make it better right now? We cannot do anything about what happened in the past, but we can still change the future with our own actions and thoughts right now.

The Earth is the environment of human activity. If we want to know events that happen to humanity, we need to clearly understand the interaction of the Earth with the laws of the universe. The more we understand, the more clearly we see how these universal laws govern the world. Once understood, people will act in accordance with these laws, no longer haphazardly or unconsciously like before. That is exactly what will happen in the coming era.

***

Thomas told me that he talked with Mr. Kris for a long time about the world in the future. And Mr. Kris said that all predictions about the future are just possibilities, things that might happen, no one can say with certainty because the future always changes depending on the transformation of humanity's consciousness as well as the developments of the Law of Cause and Effect. In addition, there are also things that are unrevealable secrets of heaven, even if you know them, you cannot say them. However, we know that the earth is always changing and operates in four periods: Formation - Persistence - Destruction - Destruction. There have been many civilizations and many different creatures present over time on this earth that we know nothing about because it once belonged to an ancient cycle.

I asked Thomas: If there were previous civilizations, why weren't there any traces left behind to prove that they had existed? Although he reminisced about his life in Atlantis, has anyone found any traces of this civilization? Currently, archaeological science has also found the skeletons of creatures that existed millions of years ago, but has not found any clear evidence of traces of ancient civilization?.

Thomas laughed and replied: "Like you, I am a person of reason so I am not easily convinced without clear evidence. Perhaps knowing that, Mr. Kris helped me remember my life in Atlantis and Egypt. Even though I had heard of it before, it was only thanks to these experiences that I truly believed that there are universal laws such as Reincarnation and Cause and Effect. I remembered my life in Atlantis and Egypt through Mr. Kris and then remembered it myself. Other lives in Greece, Rome, India, France, Germany... Thanks to my ability to recall the events of my past lives, I completely believe in the laws of the universe and understand the path I must take. In addition, I also experienced a number of other lives, each of which has its own lessons, but I think I should not tell more...

According to Mr. Kris, Atlantis is the final period or 'Death' stage of the previous civilization cycle. It should also be added that before Atlantis there were other civilizations that no one knows about now. I also wondered why there were no traces of those civilizations. Mr. Kris hypothesizes that according to the laws of the universe's development, in ancient times when we were no longer able to trace those traces, creatures must have been extremely primitive, very difficult to describe. From rudimentary creatures, they gradually transformed and evolved into animals with more distinct shapes. Before Atlantis, there were the civilizations of Lanzada, Mihtarlam, and Lemuria; people have begun to find traces, albeit faint, of these civilizations. When progressing to the Atlantean civilization, humans had the same shape as today's humans, although a bit larger. Some people think that ancient civilizations were extremely crude and barbaric, only later did they become civilized. In fact, each civilization developed according to the body's senses at that time, with different knowledge. The Atlantean civilization favored sexual instincts and had knowledge of the hidden powers in nature. Our civilization favors inference, knowledge of external objects or phenomena. Some people think that previous civilizations must collapse and disappear before the next civilization can be formed. That is not entirely true because when the Atlantis civilization was present, in some other parts of the world, there were many people like us living, although the civilization was still primitive and had not yet developed much. When the Flood occurred, some Atlanteans built boats to migrate to Egypt, South America and the Pacific islands, teaching the people there about their civilization. When these Atlanteans died, what they taught still existed for a while, as evidenced by the Pyramids and relics or strange drawings and symbols that today's science cannot explain. Aboriginal traditions in the Pacific islands all talk about giants or gods who lived with them and taught them many things."

I asked Thomas further: If so, when our civilization goes through the 'Death' stage, what will happen to the people in the next civilization? Have they been here yet and where are they now?.

Thomas nodded: "I also asked Mr. Kris the same and he said that some people are already here. These people are very similar to us but with beautiful, healthier bodies. Most of them are still children or have just been born. Most of them chose to be born into families with good moral traditions to help them continue to develop the necessary virtues. These are people with a very high level of knowledge, who have been carefully trained in the afterlife because They have a mission to develop a new civilization for humanity in the future. Their purpose is to plant the seeds of harmony, sacrifice and universal love for all. Therefore, one of the common characteristics of these children is that they do not eat meat or fish, but only like fruits and vegetables. The main task of these people is to eliminate bad habits such as greed, selfishness, pettyness and division - common diseases of humanity today. These are pioneers who vowed to reincarnate early to do good deeds. Therefore, parents who are aware of this should create appropriate circumstances and conditions to help these children develop well spiritually and have the opportunity to fulfill their mission. As the number of these people gradually increases, leaders will appear who will lead everyone, not by force or law, but by love and understanding boundless power, it not only brings peace to everyone and is also the basis of a highly advanced civilization in the future."

tieu_de: Epilogue: Thomas and I - We All Meet Again
noi_dung:
CONCLUSION

ME AND THOMAS

WE ALL MEET EACH OTHER

After many months of traveling between Pennsylvania and New York, with occasional stops in Colorado, my notes on Thomas's story can be considered temporarily complete. During that process, we had profound conversations about society, people and the world in turbulent times. Since then, our friendship has become deeper and stronger. I consider the opportunity to know and talk with Thomas to be extremely valuable, because my scientific self has gradually removed the rigid boundaries of right and wrong logic, gradually entering a world where science and spirituality are inseparable. Our final conversation before wrapping up the recording process took place at Thomas's vacation home in Colorado. At that time, we also discussed details about how to develop the story and the message we wanted to convey. Thomas hopes and also believes that the momentum his story creates can bring about subtle changes in people's minds and actions, towards a more charitable and better life.

Closing the notebook in my hand, I asked Thomas:

- Through the stories he shared with me, there is still a mystery that I don't know yet. What do you think about Mr. Kris, a man with profound and profound knowledge, knowing the past and the future? In addition, the relationship between you and Mr. Kris is surely not ordinary?

Thomas smiled:

- Mr. Kris is a very special person, a very highly qualified monk. His profound understanding did not simply come from studying in one lifetime but was the result of consistent practice over many lifetimes. This person and I have been in contact for a long time. Although Mr. Kris avoids ever talking about himself and does not mention anything about the past, thanks to past life experiences, I have understood the connection between us. I believe that Mr. Kris is my father in my life in Atlantis, the head of Arya's science school, specializing in using the jade stick to cure diseases. He was Timotheus in my Greek life, and in my Roman life he was the blue-eyed monk who guided me in the practice of meditation in Bactria. He is also the old bishop who saved my life during my life in France. In other lives, he also appeared and became a valuable companion at a certain stage of life. We have known each other for a long time and have a very special relationship. However, he was very steadfast and sincere in his path of practice, and had much more achievements than me. He is my friend but most of all he is my guide. I'm very grateful.

My speculations about Mr. Kris are correct. I nodded, thought about it, then asked more:

- He said that he also experienced many other lives but he did not tell them all. Is there anything special or inconvenient to say about those lives?

Thomas shook his head:

- Nothing special. Although I can remember many lives, I think just recounting a few lives helps me summarize experiences and knowledge that I believe can help people understand more about the laws of the universe, especially the laws of Karma and Reincarnation. As for my other lives in India, Tibet and Germany, they were just the life of a monk on the path of practice, without any significant details. It's just my own personal practice experience...

I ask again:

- Having remembered many lives, from Atlantis to now, what have you learned?

Thomas pondered then said:

- Floating through many lifetimes in the cycle of birth and death, the important thing I have learned is love. I believe that love is a lesson that everyone must learn, if not this time then another time, if not in this life then in another life. However, what is worth mentioning is that when leaving this world, due to the arrangement of karma (Karma), most people do not remember anything about what happened before, sometimes even forget the lessons they have learned, so they have to learn them over and over again. Because I realized this, in my life in India I had to ask Mr. Kris, who was my practice guide at that time, to help me in this life remember the past, so that I could continue on the path I had chosen. Cause and effect, Reincarnation is something that is easy to say, but in fact it is very difficult to explain thoroughly. No one knows how karma is arranged, because over millions of lives, when we are human, when we are animals, when we are demons, the cause and effect are so complicated that it cannot be explained or reasoned with.

Thomas was silent for a moment then continued:

- In life, we have relationships with some people, and due to some arrangement of cause and effect, we meet again in one life or another. I can assert that almost everyone I meet in my life has had a relationship with me before. It can be emotional relationships such as spouses, children, parents, relatives or it can also be acquaintance relationships such as employees in the company, classmates or trading partners and finally people born in the same city, same country or same circumstances.

I nodded:

- Indeed, in a world of billions of people, we meet this person and not that person thanks to fate, in other words, because of karma.

Thomas also nodded, then added:

- We meet many people in life, some treat us well and appreciate us, and some treat us poorly. Either way, these are cause and effect lessons that we must learn. Thinking a little more broadly, we will see that the relationships related to our lives are actually not limited to ourselves and our loved ones but also to other people. For example, before we were born, there were people who indirectly helped us, they could be the people who helped our mother when she was pregnant, the doctors and nurses who took care of her and helped us be born healthy. There are many indirect relationships like this and few people pay attention or are grateful. Continuing relationships with our peers, our teachers, or our career partners and colleagues. If we examine, we will see that there are many relationships, direct and indirect, between us and the people we meet. This shows the fact that we have relationships with many people or, more broadly, all living things. The world we live in today is an environment in which every individual, society, and country is related to each other in an invisible network. Therefore, the happiness or suffering of one person or one country cannot be separated from the happiness or suffering of all humanity. Of course, each individual has their own unique karma that comes from their concepts and actions. However, everyone also has certain beliefs that are similar, certain concepts that are similar, and certain actions that are similar, thus creating common karma. Because of that common karma, many people have to go through things like natural disasters, floods, earthquakes, wars and epidemics together.

Thomas emphasized:

- In my opinion, life is a big school in which people who are related to us will lead us to certain situations or lessons. Every decision, every choice we make is something we must learn. From these actions, the purpose of our life in this life will gradually appear, because we are born with a specific purpose, not by accident. Understanding this, each person will be serious with their every thought and action, avoid behaving arbitrarily, indulging their instincts, and they will also know to be wary of their own greed and seeds of violence. From there, we will realize that life is a classroom in which all interconnected creatures will come to the same place, one situation to learn, to help, to love, to repay or collect debts, to fulfill old wishes that we do not know clearly now. Everything that happens is a lesson about cause and effect, which has two important elements. The element of suffering urges us to learn and the element of love helps us solve the other lesson. If we can clearly understand love, almost anything can be solved.

I asked:

- Is love alone enough? Do you believe that love can solve everything?

Thomas nodded:

- Love is also a law of the universe. Unfortunately, not many people understand this. Most people misunderstand love, because they let selfishness or ego control them. Nowadays, people understand love in a limited way as an exchange. If you give, you must receive in return, and sometimes, if not reciprocated, love can immediately turn into jealousy, anger or hatred. That is conditional love.

Thomas pondered then said:

- I learned about love from my life in Egypt through meeting Cihone. At that time I only had a vague concept of love. Cihone's noble soul touched and made a powerful Pharaoh like me respect her and not dare to violate her. In that life, for me, love was assimilated with power and desire. It was only when I met her that I vaguely realized the existence of unconditional love. Just like in Atlantis, my last feelings for the goddess Kor were just pity, a feeling of regret, not true love. Because I didn't know anything about true love, I did something wrong to her. It was a cause that had been sown that, when the conditions were right, would bear fruit. It was that cause that made me pay the price as a slave who was treated cruelly, humiliated, and eventually killed. In the past, I caused the death of the saintess Kor, so the time has come for me to repay that debt to her.

I vaguely realized the connection that Thomas was mentioning so I quickly asked:

- Having said that, is Isidora in Greece the saintess Kor?

Thomas smiled:

- That's right, she also experienced many other lives and also had her own lessons to learn. In Greece, she was born noble and beautiful, but had to learn a bitter lesson when Cassander refused to kiss her, was humiliated by her friends, and finally had to marry Deasius, a widower, cruel and greedy... In this life, I paid her back for the pain and sadness that I had caused her in the previous life, but she also extended the cycle of cause and effect between us by treating me cruelly, and that's why. We also met again in other lives to settle the remaining debts.

I nodded:

- I understand, the debt of cause and effect between people is indeed very intertwined, it is difficult to repay it all in one lifetime, because when paying the result we also unintentionally sow new causes. If so, what is his relationship with Melissa?

Anything that benefits everyone is a good deed. If we help people out of love, not to gain fame or to be rewarded, it is a good deed. When you work sincerely, not selfishly, not for personal gain, not thinking about yourself but only caring for others, that is a good deed. On the contrary, if we do anything that harms others or benefits ourselves, it is evil. The standard for distinguishing between good and evil is self-introspection to see who the action benefits? If you do it for others, it is a good deed. If you do it for your own benefit and harm others, it is an unhealthy deed.

Thomas said immediately:

- Melissa is a noble woman, willing to sacrifice everything for her husband. Don't you think that's very familiar? She is the ancient Queen Nedjem. Although she was the wife of a powerful Pharaoh, she was not favored or loved and had to live alone in the palace, but she silently accepted and endured because she only wished for Egypt to be stable and prosperous. Likewise, in Greece, Melissa was a faithful wife to Leonidas, treated Yasamin kindly, who stole her husband and still loved and cared for her husband's stepson.

I have doubts:

- But Nedjem is a tolerant, resilient and kind woman, I think she will not have to experience such an incomplete marriage again. Why is Nedjem like that and Melissa not happy?

Thomas shook his head slightly:

- It's not that simple. As we said, cause and effect is an intricate and complex system, each of our lives is not only an opportunity to pay off the debts we have incurred, but also a place where we learn. There are many lessons to learn, sometimes we have to learn them in different circumstances, to ensure that we have truly learned that lesson. Furthermore, Melissa chose to live honestly and tolerantly. At that time, she also sowed good causes and then received sweet results. The laws of the universe are not wrong, they are immutable, it's just that we don't have enough vision to see through them.

I nodded, even more interested in the connections across lifetimes. I asked:

- What about Leonidas, what is your relationship with Leonidas?

Thomas smiled:

- As mentioned, people who have a relationship often come back together because of some complicated fate. Leonidas and I have been in contact for a long time. You may remember that during my life in Assyria, I had an older brother, Nimurta, who was passionate about music and women. In Greece, he met me again as Leonidas. Leonidas and I were close until we went to Persia, when our friendship changed somewhat. Later, we met again during our lives in Germany. At that time, he was my cousin, a talented musician but still passionate about gambling and women, often borrowing money from me and never paying it back. Therefore, in this life, Wilson G spent a lot of money investing in my company...

I was startled:

- So that's it. I didn't expect him and Wilson to have such a deep relationship. So what about Cihone? Is there any predestined relationship between him and her?

Thomas nodded:

- In life, there will be meetings that we think are just coincidences, but in fact, they all have previous connections. I knew nothing about Cihone, the woman who used love to heal diseases in Egypt, but thanks to Mr. Kris's help, I learned that in the past Cihone was a holy woman in the temple of the goddess Isis and had many powers. Although the meeting with her in my life in Egypt was very short, somehow she knew that I needed to learn about love, so in my life in Rome, as Valeria, she indirectly created the lesson that I needed to learn.

I was surprised:

- I didn't expect Cihone to be Valeria...

Thomas smiled and slowly added:

- Thanks to Valeria, I know God's love, an unconditional, infinite love. This is an important lesson, because for most people, all love is conditional and limited by selfishness and greed. Because of my relationship with Valeria, I was allowed by Mr. Beria to follow the trade group to Bactria and continue my unfinished practice. Unfortunately, at that time I was still influenced by many inferiority complexes due to my family's treatment, so in my heart I still wanted to prove my abilities, wanted to become a hero, so after a period of practice, I quit to return to Syria to help Beria restore order in Rome. This was a big mistake on my learning path. Therefore, cause and effect arranged for me to go through another life, relearning my lessons.

I asked further:

- You said just now that you met Kor, aka Isidora, again, so when did you two meet again?

Thomas suddenly felt a bit thoughtful:

- It was Ella in her life in France. In this life, I had no sympathy and often abandoned Ella because in my heart I still looked down on the Gitan people as a low class. That is also the lack of understanding that comes from being treated cruelly in the past, but fortunately during the short moment of living at the monastery, experiencing sincere daily prayer with the priests, I became aware of the lesson of God's love, a love that is infinite and unconditional. That was the reason why I had to find Ella to reconnect with the old story, use love to solve a cause and from then on we both decided to go together...

Attracted to the story, I impatiently interrupted:

- Will you see Ella again after that?

Thomas continued the narrative:

- Because of a special relationship with the Indian teacher and Timotheus, or Mr. Kris, I was reincarnated back to Bactria, India and Tibet to continue my path of practice. During these three lifetimes, Mr. Kris and I were both Buddhist monks and made a lot of progress. The difference is that Mr. Kris has long been very aware of his path while I still have some causes and effects that need to be resolved. Because I knew that, during my life in India, I asked him to help me remember my past life and the lessons I needed to learn...

I asked again:

- Did you see Ella again?

Thomas looked at me and smiled:

- Of course! We had a covenant to be together so we met again in this life...

I was startled:

- You mean Angie?

Thomas nodded:

- Angie doesn't know anything about this. Through many lifetimes, each person has their own causes as well as lessons that need to be learned. Currently, because I remember the past, I am waiting for the right time to try to lead Angie back to the spiritual path.

I said:

- The things you shared today brought me too many surprises...

Thomas affirmed:

- Therefore, I want to make it clear that almost everyone we meet has had relationships from the past. This clearly shows the mystery of the Law of Cause and Effect. There is no cause that does not bear fruit. It is a very natural event, without any errors and never changing. If you do good, you will receive good, and if you do evil, you will have to pay back evil. This is a universal law, not a superstition. Of course, those who do not believe will act haphazardly and will suffer the consequences, and so on. The more they don't believe, the more they commit crimes. When the cause and effect bear fruit, they refuse to believe that the crime was caused by themselves, thinking that it was a coincidence. Thus, they do not learn the lesson, so they continue to drift in constant suffering, from life to life. People who understand and believe in cause and effect know how to be vigilant and think carefully about the consequences of whatever they do. If you believe that love can solve everything, you must know how to apply this rule in life. Whatever happens is a lesson, karma must be paid, but use love to solve it, don't create more causes. Each choice, each decision should not be based solely on temporary emotions but must be wise based on an understanding of the laws of the universe.

Thomas suddenly looked straight at me and said:

- You and I have also met each other in the past, so as soon as we met, we had sympathy and were close immediately. Mr. Kris also knew him well, but he said this was something he would have to figure out for himself.

This was something I had vaguely realized myself, so I was not surprised but just nodded slightly, feeling speechless. I shook Thomas's hand, we clasped each other's hands, filled with trust and understanding. The room was quiet, only the ticking sound of the clock, suddenly, Angie's voice rang out from the dining room outside:

- Please put aside the conversation and invite John out to eat, I've already finished preparing.

Hearing Angie calling, Thomas and I immediately stood up. Before stepping out, we both looked out the window without appointment. The sunlight shines through the pine branches fluttering in the wind, creating sparkling rays of sunlight, dancing like small fluttering butterfly wings. Deep inside, my soul seems to be awakening on its own journey of enlightenment...

The true self is present everywhere, in all things, but because of confusion, we keep looking everywhere. The true self already exists, so there is no need to search for it. We just need to turn inward to transform the ego, transform consciousness into wisdom, not looking for anything else. When the three karmas of body, speech, and mind are pure, we will know our true self.

tieu_de: Words of Gratitude to Professor John Vu - Nguyen Phong
noi_dung:
THANK YOU TO PROFESSOR JOHN VU - NGUYEN PHONG

Since Journey to the East appeared in Vietnam in 1974, the book has helped many people change their minds with profound, mysterious messages, guided through a fascinating journey of spiritual search. During the following decades, the book silently spread, moved and spiritually awakened many people. The most interesting thing is that at that time, almost no one knew that the person who adapted the book, who had the simple name Nguyen Phong, was a world-class professor currently in the US - Professor John Vu. John Vu was for many years a chief engineer at Boeing. He is also a Distinguished Professor of Computer Science at Carnegie Mellon University, where he is Director of the Biotechnology and Computational Innovation program.

During the copyright contact so that First News - Tri Viet could print the book Journey to the East and the books that Nguyen Phong adapted many years ago, I had a conversation with Professor John Vu and that conversation became a lucky chance to start a soul-mate that I deeply cherish. Professor John Vu and I have had many conversations about different topics related to knowledge and society. Once the professor accidentally shared Thomas's story, I had a hunch that it was a story that needed to be told, needed to be spread, because of its good and awakening values. I urgently request the professor to write a book telling this story, to spread good things and awaken people from ignorance, conflict, greed and selfishness - things that are destroying human spirit, life, civilization and at the same time causing the earth of all species to buckle and call for help.

When I received the manuscript of Human Life, I stayed up many nights to read the entire book. With the intuition of a person who has been making books for many years and with a guiding spirit, I realized that Forever Lives is a book with a special mission to the community. Immediately, I and the First News team worked day and night on this precious book so that it could soon be brought to readers' hands. Since the first volume appeared, the book has been warmly received by readers and created a publishing record in Vietnam. This strengthens my belief that if we are frightened when we see the negative energies of greed, conflict, and destruction, which are spreading rapidly across the globe like a toxic virus, let us also believe that good things can create a tsunami that changes human consciousness.

The most special thing is that this book about Cause and Effect and Reincarnation was written by a reputable scientist, so the scope of expansion and interference of spirituality and science seems to have no limit. It is this special book that has changed the minds of me and the First News brothers as well as many Vietnamese readers. The message from Human Life has opened the door leading readers into a pure, spacious spiritual world, where there is no short-sighted distinction between spirituality and science, but only a deep understanding of the laws of the universe, helping people to be good, altruistic, and charitable to rebuild a new, better and more loving world.

In Forever Lives episode 3, Nguyen Phong along with the main character Thomas and enlightened master Kris gave messages towards great love and suggested and guided readers on the journey of awakening that everyone can aim for.

Through Human Life, I understand that the professor's greatest wish is to contribute to bringing people to the path of goodness, hoping that all humanity can live in peace, charity, and altruism, regardless of skin color, nationality and religion. I believe that Human lifehas been, is and will continue its journey to fulfill its mission of good, the mission of becoming a bridge for every small person to be united with great things. I am personally grateful to Professor John Vu for giving me the opportunity to join him in spreading the good values ​​of this book to Vietnamese readers. At the same time, I would like, on behalf of the Vietnamese readers who have had the opportunity to approach and love this book, to send Professor John Vu my sincere feelings and deep gratitude for the enthusiasm, love and effort he has put into this especially meaningful work as well as for the mission of bringing people to kindness.

Nguyen Van Phuoc Founder of First News - Tri Viet
